title: The Drawing of the Three
author: Stephen King
summary: In Stephen King's Dark Tower series, a lone gunslinger pursues a mysterious man across a ruined world. In this second book, he finds doors on a shore that open into our own world, and the people behind them matter to his quest.
readIf: you like King's weirder side, with western grit, strange doors and characters thrown together.
skipIf: you have not read The Gunslinger, or you dislike graphic violence and drug use.

pairings.reason: The first Dark Tower book, which sets up Roland and the world.
Another large King story of ordinary people drawn into a battle between good and evil.
A grim, episodic fantasy about a weary professional wandering a dangerous world.
